rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a hatching blastocyst with zona breach, expanded cavity, loosely grouped ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with 4BA. Minor overinterpretation of fine details not clearly discernible in a single static image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte yield, prior cycle, semen quality, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from morphology and patient factors to prognosis. Minor issues include somewhat speculative adjustments and overconfident interpretation of DOR classification/protocol effects.

Mostly aligned on SET and general embryo assessment, but includes recommendations that are more controversial or not routinely guideline-supported after limited failure (e.g., ERA, thrombophilia/immunologic workup, routine progesterone targets/additional estradiol).

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including protocol reconsideration and follow-up strategy. Slightly reduced by inclusion of some speculative or nonstandard investigations.
